API ReferenceBusiness Insights APIReportsDownload a Report
Download a Report
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/report/download

Download a particular report file. Returns text/csv by default, or application/octet-stream when gzip compression is requested.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
compression
string

Possible values: [gzip]

Compression type for the report file. Only 'gzip' is supported.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
fileName
string
REQUIRED

File name of the report to download.

reportType
string
REQUIRED

Type of report.

Possible values: [APPLICATION, DATA_EXPLORER, WORKPLACE]

subType
string

Subtype of report.

Possible values: [CustomDataFeed, ScheduledReports, SaveAndSchedule]

Default value: CustomDataFeed
Examples
Download an APPLICATION ScheduledReports report
Download a WORKPLACE CustomDataFeed report
Download a DATA_EXPLORER SaveAndSchedule report
Responses
​
200
400
401
405
415
429
500

Report downloaded successfully.

*/*
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
string
binary
